text: A tall, slender figure with pale skin and long white hair flows down their back. Their face is elongated, eyes closed in anguish as they clutch their head. Wearing a deep purple robe over dark undergarments, cinched at the waist with a black belt. Kneeling on one knee, arms raised to forehead. Behind them, two figures in red cloaks embrace; three distant warriors stand with spears. The scene is icy and cavernous, lit by cool blue light.
